- Everyone in #strategic-random is also in #strategic-pod and #inc-vtg-hartford, so nothing there is hidden from them today. If membership changes, I'll leave out any channel that not everyone in the channel can see.
- Finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms) and finance documents stay out. Operational facts such as dates, seat counts, ticket numbers and contacts are included.

An admin needs to fix the Gateway scheduler auth first. Let me know when that's done and I'll create the job. I won't post a test brief today, since that would be an unrequested post.
